title: Honeydew vs FutureClinic for acne, rosacea and psoriasis
summary: Honeydew vs FutureClinic for acne, rosacea and psoriasis compares Honeydew's cost without insurance and clinicians with a $40 FutureClinic doctor visit.
body_markdown:
## How much does Honeydew cost without insurance compared with FutureClinic?


On[Honeydew's pricing page](https://www.honeydew.com/pricing) as of October 2026, your first consultation is free, and billing starts afterward. Basic Membership is $39 a month (three-month minimum), $32 a month ($129 every four months), or $25 a month ($299 a year; code YEARLY25 takes $25 off annual plans). Canceling before three months carries a $26 penalty under[Honeydew's terms of service](https://www.honeydew.com/policies/terms-of-service) , with no prorated refunds.


Honeydew's membership covers "all of your virtual consultations, medication management, ongoing support," so its price assumes you stay subscribed while receiving care. On FutureClinic, there is no subscription needed: pay $40 for the best-fit doctor, or pick a chosen doctor's listed price, typically $20 to $100. If your doctor decides it's right for you and judges a stable medicine safe, they can prescribe several months at once. Two $40 visits over a year cost $80 in doctor fees, versus $299 on Honeydew's annual plan. Most FutureClinic doctors also offer an optional membership: unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time, typically $25 to $100 a month (up to 100 responses monthly by law), and your visit fee counts toward it.


As Honeydew notes in its FAQ, "we do not sell our own medication." Both services send prescriptions to outside pharmacies where you can use insurance, including[Medicare and Medicaid prescription benefits](https://www.honeydew.com/faq/does-honeydew-accept-insurance) on Honeydew, and both help get a prior authorization when insurance needs one. On FutureClinic, prescriptions go to the pharmacy you choose, including mail-order pharmacies that deliver to your door, with a discount coupon for the best cash price.


## Isotretinoin (Accutane), biologics and where Honeydew is a strong option


Honeydew states on its home page as of October 2026 that it prescribes "real treatments like Accutane, Dupixent, Skyrizi, and more," and "We also manage all iPLEDGE requirements, monthly check-ins, and lab monitoring." On its[pricing page](https://www.honeydew.com/pricing) as of October 2026, Accutane Membership is $64 a month (three-month minimum), $57 a month ($229 per four months), or $50 a month annual ($299 a year plus $25 monthly). Cash isotretinoin is capped at $30 to $50 per box on its[Accutane page](https://www.honeydew.com/treatments/accutane) (around $65 in the FAQ), or as low as $0 with insurance.


Honeydew is a strong option if you live outside FutureClinic's 33 states and Washington, D.C. (Honeydew covers all 50 states and Washington, D.C.), want video visits within 48 hours, want Honeydew's custom-compounded formulas, or want monthly skin visits all year at $299 a year ($25 a month as of October 2026). On FutureClinic, care is by message only. Isotretinoin is prescribed only by dermatologists who choose to offer it, managing iPLEDGE and discounted lab orders by message if your doctor decides it's right for you.


## Acne, rosacea, or psoriasis care by message, from your AI app


FutureClinic works in 33 states and Washington, D.C.: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. If you do not see your state listed, try anyway as coverage expands.


You can reach FutureClinic from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot, Meta Muse, and Instinct, bringing your AI's context so you do not repeat yourself. Start at[https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) , see our guides to[add a doctor to Claude](https://futureclinic.com/blog/how-to-add-a-doctor-to-claude) or[add a real doctor to ChatGPT](https://futureclinic.com/blog/how-to-add-a-real-doctor-to-chatgpt) , or send your AI this setup line:` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt`


Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want. Or start on[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) and read our[editorial standards](https://futureclinic.com/blog/editorial-standards) . FutureClinic is not for emergencies; call 911 in an emergency, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
